action_plan.issue: Users router has no requireOrgAccess — any authenticated user can access any user's data
action_plan.action: Add requireOrgAccess middleware or per-route org membership checks on users router

action_plan.issue: Admin search has no org scope — returns results across all organizations
action_plan.action: Add organization_id filter to search queries or requireOrgAccess middleware

action_plan.issue: Profiles router has no org check — any authenticated user can access any profile
action_plan.action: Add requireOrgAccess or limit profile reads to user's own org members

action_plan.issue: Session cookie may lack proper SameSite=Strict and Secure flags — CSRF token not confirmed
action_plan.action: Explicitly set cookie with httpOnly=true, secure=true, sameSite='strict', path='/'

action_plan.issue: Tables defined in migrations but never queried in API code: IF, if
action_plan.action: Either add API endpoints for these tables or remove them from migrations

action_plan.issue: Bulk invite operations not wrapped in a Supabase RPC transaction — partial invite failure leaves inconsistent state
action_plan.action: Move bulk invite logic into a Supabase RPC function with BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK

action_plan.issue: PII fields (email, phone, full_name) stored in profiles table without encryption at rest
action_plan.action: Enable Transparent Column Encryption (TCE) or Supabase Vault for PII columns

action_plan.issue: Bulk operation in 2 file(s) uses catch+console.error instead of checking per-item .ok status
action_plan.action: Return {ok, error} per item from API and surface partial failures in UI with detailed error list

action_plan.issue: Auth rate limit is per-IP only — attacker can rotate IPs via botnet to brute-force passwords
action_plan.action: Add per-email rate limiting (max 5 attempts per email per 15min) in addition to per-IP limit

action_plan.issue: Prod terraform apply gated by prod-approval environment but no required E2E/test workflow_call dependency before apply
action_plan.action: Add needs: [validate, e2e] to terraform-apply-prod job

action_plan.issue: Domain routing middleware runs on every request — adds JWT decode overhead even on static assets
action_plan.action: Use Next.js matcher config to exclude _next/static, favicon.ico from middleware execution (already done in config)

action_plan.issue: Circuit breaker state changes are not exported as Prometheus metrics
action_plan.action: Add prom-client Gauge to track circuit breaker state (0=closed, 1=open, 2=half-open)
